name: browser-use
headline: Jean - Automate Projects & Sessions
short_description: Jean manages multiple projects, worktrees, and sessions with Claude CLI. It automates worktree management, loads context from sessions, GitHub issues, and pull requests, and executes Git commands. Operations teams benefit from streamlined workflows and reduced manual effort.
author: coollabsio

sections.overview:
Jean is a project and worktree management automation tool designed for Claude CLI users handling multiple concurrent projects. It automates the creation and management of Git worktrees, loads context directly from saved sessions, GitHub issues, and pull requests, and executes Git commands programmatically. The tool eliminates repetitive manual setup tasks, allowing developers and operations teams to focus on code rather than environment configuration. Jean integrates with Claude's CLI backend to provide streamlined access to project context and reduce context-switching overhead in multi-project environments.
Managing multiple Git worktrees across different project branches simultaneously
Loading GitHub issue and pull request context directly into Claude sessions
Automating Git command execution for repetitive worktree operations
Streamlining multi-project workflows with pre-configured session contexts
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/coollabsio/jean`
sections.usage:
```
Use Jean to automate worktree management for [PROJECT_NAME]. Load context from [SESSION_NAME] or [GITHUB_ISSUE_URL/PR_URL]. Execute Git commands to sync branches, resolve conflicts, or push changes. Report the final state of the worktree and any actions taken.
```
Copy

```
Jean initialized a new worktree for the `feature/user-authentication` project from the main branch. It loaded context from the active session `dev-session-2024` and fetched the latest changes from GitHub issue #1234 ("Add OAuth2 support"). Jean executed the following commands:

```bash
git checkout -b feature/user-authentication origin/main
git merge --no-ff origin/main
git push --set-upstream origin feature/user-authentication
```

The worktree is now at commit `a1b2c3d4` with no conflicts. All changes from the issue and session were applied successfully. The branch is up-to-date with remote and ready for review. No manual intervention was required.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
